def transform2(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop();cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]==color:
              seen.add((ny,nx));stack.append((ny,nx))
        y0=min(y for y,x in cells);y1=max(y for y,x in cells);x0=min(x for y,x in cells);x1=max(x for y,x in cells)
        perimeter={(y,x) for y in range(y0,y1+1) for x in range(x0,x1+1) if y in (y0,y1) or x in (x0,x1)}
        if set(cells)==perimeter and y1-y0>=2 and x1-x0>=2:
          fill=2 if (y1-y0-1)%2==0 and (x1-x0-1)%2==0 else 7
          for y in range(y0+1,y1):
            for x in range(x0+1,x1):out[y][x]=fill
    return out
